notes.title: New localization, new features and weapon balance in version 1.1.5.
notes.notes:
The level up and XP system will now save the player's progress continuously and not just when the game is auto saved.

Added Russian language localization to dialogues, menus, and the store page.

The weapon menu will now also close with the escape key.

When exiting the vehicle, the weapon will be automatically drawn.

The Negev machine gun base damage was increased for a better balance between weapons.

A new message on the save / load page to clarify how the game saves your progress.

Fixed the quick use weapon buttons so they will not allow double slots for the same weapon.

The way point marker system was improved and it's bug fixed.

Character lip sync is improved.

Lock picking mini game has been fixed and works more correctly.

Added a user icon for computers that have content.

I fixed some bugs, unclear instructions, text misspelling and an inventory image.

notes.title: Demo patch
notes.notes:
Car trunk closing bug is fixed (the player will not get locked on close the trunk).
Player explosives now can hurt the player if he is too close.
Invert Y is now a settings feature.
Better lip sync accuracy.
Some other bugs fixed.
